name: Genetic Cystic Renal Disease

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Genetic Cystic Renal Disease Diagnostic Criteria

criteria.description: Presence of multiple bilateral renal cysts detected by imaging
Positive family history of cystic renal disease or related genetic mutations
Identification of pathogenic mutation in genes associated with cystic renal disease (e.g., PKD1, PKD2, UMOD)
Presence of extrarenal cysts or related systemic features (e.g., hepatic cysts, pancreatic cysts)

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of multiple bilateral renal cysts plus either a positive family history or pathogenic genetic mutation
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic testing is recommended to confirm diagnosis and guide prognosis.

pathognomonic.notes: Detected by ultrasound or CT imaging

pathognomonic.symptomName: Familial clustering of cystic kidney disease

searchTerms: high blood pressure from kidney problems
blood pressure increase due to kidney issues

common.symptomName: Flank pain due to cyst enlargement or hemorrhage
searchTerms: flank pain due to cyst growth
pain from cyst bleeding in kidney

common.symptomName: Chronic kidney disease symptoms (e.g., edema, fatigue related to renal failure)
searchTerms: swelling and tiredness from kidney disease

laboratory: Elevated serum creatinine and blood urea nitrogen indicating renal impairment
imaging: Ultrasound or CT demonstrating multiple bilateral renal cysts
MRI for detection of intracranial aneurysms in at-risk patients
genetic: Pathogenic variants in PKD1, PKD2, UMOD, or other cystic kidney disease-associated genes
other: Family history consistent with autosomal dominant or recessive inheritance patterns

distinguishingFeatures: Usually adult onset with large renal cysts
Common extrarenal manifestations including liver cysts and intracranial aneurysms
Typically presents in childhood or adolescence
Small to normal-sized kidneys with corticomedullary cysts
Progressive renal failure without large cysts

redFlags: Recurrent gross hematuria with flank pain
Family history of early-onset end-stage renal disease
references: Torres VE, Harris PC, Pirson Y. Autosomal dominant polycystic kidney disease. Lancet. 2007 Apr 14;369(9569):1287-301.
Harris PC, Rossetti S. Molecular genetics of autosomal dominant polycystic kidney disease. J Am Soc Nephrol. 2004 Oct;15(10):2544-53.
